backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor defining a placeholder backend canister.
feature_evidence.json: Report mapping implemented features to related source files and components for build verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains human-written summaries of key frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode variants, and base typography/background rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting meta tags, fonts, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the CoffeeLandingPage.
frontend/src/components/CoffeeFooter.tsx: Footer with branding, navigation links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/CoffeeTopNav.tsx: Responsive top navigation bar with scroll behavior, anchor links, and mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and AuthClient initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future React Query hooks; no logic implemented.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, typography, and a custom coffee-themed light/dark color system with global styles and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/CoffeeLandingPage.tsx: Implements the main landing page with hero, menu, testimonials, and supporting UI components using a coffee‑themed design.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, extended theming, utilities, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, required features, image requirements, and overall state for the coffee website build.
